record.name: BigCommerce
record.one_liner: BigCommerce provides REST and GraphQL APIs to manage store data, authenticate customers, and build headless ecommerce storefronts.

auth.notes: BigCommerce APIs use OAuth-based API accounts and token authentication passed via headers such as X-Auth-Token.

access.notes: Developers can sign up for a free BigCommerce trial store and generate API credentials directly in the store control panel under Settings > API Accounts.

api_surface.notes: Offers REST Store Management APIs, REST Storefront API, and GraphQL Storefront API.

mcp.notes: Reported value was discarded: no support offered.

buildability.reasoning: Credentials are self-serve (oauth2) and the pages document a usable API surface. (Derived from access, auth and api_surface.)

evidence.claim: Access is self-serve via creating a sandbox trial and generating credentials in settings.
evidence.quote: Sign up for a free BigCommerce trial store to test API calls and build integrations without affecting live data.
BigCommerce offers three types of OAuth-based API accounts to developers who wish to use BigCommerce’s REST APIs: store-level credentials, app-level credentials, and account-level credentials.

evidence.claim: Supports both REST and GraphQL APIs.
evidence.quote: BigCommerce has several APIs that let you manage store data, authenticate customers, make client-side queries for product information, and more.
